title: Full test suite in a pinned git worktree so development continues in the main tree (REQ-0065)
requirement: REQ-0065 AC1-AC6: run_all in a worktree pinned to a commit; root vars reset; main-tree scans skip it; cleanup; tester can start it.
acceptance_criteria: 102.1 run_all --worktree [commit] runs the suite in a pinned worktree and the SUMMARY carries the tested sha
102.2 an edit in the main tree mid-run does not change the result
102.3 suites resolve the worktree (root vars reset)
102.4 worktree outside the repo, one reusable test-run slot, stale ones pruned
102.5 failing-suite logs land in the main tree work/<T>/evidence; main .claude/state untouched
102.6 tasks.sh recover cleans a crashed run
$0, no stash/reset, secrets dirs not copied in

design.summary: run_all --worktree hands off to tests/run_worktree.sh: reusable test-run worktree outside the repo pinned to the commit, copy-in of ignored test data, failing logs written back, SUMMARY tagged (tested @sha); failed worktree kept, --no-keep drops

implementation.summary: run_all.sh --worktree handoff, tests/run_worktree.sh (slot, lock, status/clean), worktree_sync.py, SUMMARY tag, recover hook, U1-U10 test

unit_test.result: run_worktree 53/0; --fast 163 suites, only known track_hook S3 fails (also on clean HEAD); shell.sh 573/0

security.result: deny list excludes secrets/ext results; root inside repo refused; no network

verification.result: real worktree run pinned 920a6b47, tag and BYPRODUCTS 0; recover clean

tester.waiver: guard blocks git worktree for roles; main ran run_worktree_test, --fast gate and the real worktree row (work/TASK-102/evidence)

verifier.waiver: guard blocks git worktree for roles; main saved the evidence

crosscheck.waiver: harness-only change, checked by real worktree run

user_notes.note: run full suite in a git worktree (./branch_worktree_test...) so dev continues in root; plan only for now
control worktree lifecycle: reuse/update one slot, rotate kept failures
worktree must carry gitignored test data, copied from the main tree at run start (deny list: caches, locks, local settings, guard logs, secrets, work/); AC9
sync back only evidence + failing-suite logs to main work/<T>/evidence; list worktree byproducts, never copy them over plans/reports/ai_store; AC10
user agreed AC9/AC10; run save-evidence.sh from the main tree, cd into the worktree only for the suite
